links.comparator_used: Ambient-only documentation generated from the physician-patient conversation transcript, without historical EHR data
links.outcome: QNOTE assessment composite score (documentation completeness, clinical coherence, clarity, conciseness) for diabetes and hypertension encounters
links.effect: Mean total assessment composite 94.8 vs. 80.1 (scale 0-100); difference 14.6 points; 95% CI 13.4-15.8; P<0.001. Largest improvement in completeness domain (difference 42.5 points; P<0.001). DM and HTN showed similar results.
links.quote: Consolidated documentation achieved significantly higher mean total assessment composite score compared to ambient-only (94.8 vs. 80.1 on a scale of 0-100; difference 14.6 points; 95% CI 13.4-15.8; P<0.001).

design_hint: augmenting ambient documentation with historical EHR data
